svg.aria-label: Things I've done: Shipped 200+ videos with an automated pipeline. Topic → script → voice → render → upload → analytics. Then traced a zero-views problem to 6 separate root causes in a single session. | Built multi-provider API failover. Key rotation, rate-limit fallback, and dead-endpoint pruning. Moved every key out of plaintext into environment variables and sweep-verified nothing leaked. | Automated my own ops. Scheduled tasks health-check every API provider nightly and log uptime and latency trends. Weekly secret-free backups, plus a rebuild guide for disaster recovery. | Rescued a 2.85 GiB corrupted git history. Turned it into a clean ~475 KB repo with an automated backup script. | Worked around tight hardware. Cut ~720 MB of disk writes per render by piping frames between processes. Traced a memory crash on a 7.2 GB machine to shared GPU/system RAM. | Built a PXE network-boot server from scratch. Reinstalled a laptop with no USB stick, then turned it into a LAN file server. | Shut down a project after auditing it honestly. Its headline feature was cosmetic, not functional. Salvaged the parts that worked (decision ledger, multi-API fallback, analytics cache) into later pipelines.

g.text: Shipped 200+ videos with an automated pipeline
Topic → script → voice → render → upload → analytics. Then traced a zero-views problem to 6
separate root causes in a single session.
Key rotation, rate-limit fallback, and dead-endpoint pruning. Moved every key out of plaintext
into environment variables and sweep-verified nothing leaked.
Scheduled tasks health-check every API provider nightly and log uptime and latency trends. Weekly
secret-free backups, plus a rebuild guide for disaster recovery.

Cut ~720 MB of disk writes per render by piping frames between processes. Traced a memory crash on
a 7.2 GB machine to shared GPU/system RAM.

Reinstalled a laptop with no USB stick, then turned it into a LAN file server.
Shut down a project after auditing it honestly
Its headline feature was cosmetic, not functional. Salvaged the parts that worked (decision
ledger, multi-API fallback, analytics cache) into later pipelines.
